text: The shoulder strap snapped after two weeks of light use. Very disappointed with the quality.
Keeps water cold all day and the lid never leaks. Great purchase.
The gloves run two sizes small and the stitching came loose on the thumb.
Battery lasts for three nights of camping and the beam is great. Love it.
The ignition button stopped working on the second trip and support never answered.
Fits my pack well and kept everything dry in heavy rain. Excellent value.
